posts.body_html: So my leucos are way early this year - none had significant traps open until the second week of September in 2013, but this past week a couple of really nice pitchers opened with many, many more on the way! Here is the first trap on WRR - it's going to look even better in a week or two when all the traps are open...

posts.body_html:
Here is my WRR as of today. I got this guy from Mike only last winter and it has done phenomenally for me so far. It put out a couple nice spring pitchers too, which is always a nice bonus on a leuco clone. Overall I'd say this is the finest leuco in my collection at the current time, judged on size, color, shape, and vigor. These pitchers are about 24" - I know it will get a lot bigger with time and when it's not shoehorned into a 4" pot LOL!

There's one more pitcher hiding back there:

Love this plant

posts.body_html: The large spring pitchers on my WRR have colored up really well in the past few weeks. The plant has really established nicely since I got it from Mike in winter 2013. The pitcher on the left is 32.5 inches tall - whereas last season's fall pitchers were only 24". Needless to say I'm looking forward to this year's fall crop. I have heard this clone can hit 36" in the fall and I don't doubt that for a second!
